items.name: preview-picker
items.title: preview-picker
items.description: a controlled selector for preview examples and languages, with optional icons, disabled choices and wrapping

items.name: tokens
items.title: tokens
items.description: the studio's voice on top of shadcn's neutral theme: three type voices, semantic tones, the alpha ladder, motion. import it once from globals.css

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: theme-toggle
items.description: light, dark and follow-the-system as one radio group; provider-agnostic, so it takes a value and a setter rather than owning the theme

items.name: code
items.title: code
items.description: a code block highlighted on the server by shiki: marked lines, diffs, focus and word marks, both themes in one render, copy built in

items.name: copy
items.title: copy
items.description: copy to the clipboard, confirmed in place and never with a toast; a button, or the hook behind any control you like

items.name: scroll-stage
items.title: scroll-stage
items.description: the pinned stage: a tall track, a sticky stage, --stage-p driven by CSS scroll-driven animation, acts as checkpoints

items.name: reveal
items.title: reveal
items.description: content that arrives as it enters the viewport, once or scroll-tied, with optional stagger

items.name: scrims
items.title: scrims
items.description: viewport fogs at top and bottom, scroll-linked, never transitioned

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: liquid-glass
items.description: translucent glass with inset reflections and a directional rim; typed shapes and tones, Tailwind overrides, and polymorphic composition

items.name: avatar
items.title: avatar
items.description: a person's face, the same object everywhere it appears: one round crop on the studio's rungs, positioned on the subject from the portrait's sidecar, ringed in the picture's own colour, and opening the full portrait alone in a lightbox of its own when it is worth a look

items.name: quote
items.title: quote
items.description: somebody else's words, and the social preview of them: the card and the still read one set of rules, so a shared link and the page it opens cannot drift apart

items.name: quote-card
items.title: quote-card
items.description: a quote's rules: the accent it keeps, the size ladder its text is set at, the wrap, and the SVG still. framework-free, so a build script or an og route can draw one without React

items.name: terminal
items.title: terminal
items.description: a phosphor terminal that plays a session script live; the still renderer in terminal-session draws the same frame

items.name: terminal-session
items.title: terminal-session
items.description: the session script the terminal plays: parse, palette, timeline, and the SVG still renderer that draws the same frame. framework-free, so a build script can render a still without React

items.name: web-preview-unfurl
items.title: web-preview-unfurl
items.description: the five facts of a link (site, title, description, image, icon) and the one fetch that reads them from a page; framework-free, run once at authoring time and shipped as data

items.name: web-preview
items.title: web-preview
items.description: a link's unfurl as a card, a pure function of its five facts, in three styles: ours (image at its aspect, title at reading size, domain as metadata), telegram's tinted card with the rule, x's large-image card

items.name: device-frame
items.title: device-frame
items.description: Responsive iPhone, MacBook and Studio Display hardware frames for any app content.

items.name: telegram-chat
items.title: telegram-chat
items.description: a Telegram chat as a pure function of {messages, progress}: peer, bot and group shapes, people defined once, streaming bodies, pressable reactions with animated emoji, afterlife. on an iPhone, or frameless at the container's width; focus lifts a message and blurs the rest; crop cuts the phone to a viewport, for a scrolly

items.name: telegram-summary
items.title: telegram-summary
items.description: a link-summary bot's conversation (intro, link, mention, streamed answer) built on telegram-chat

items.name: lightbox
items.title: lightbox
items.description: one interruptible spring over a view: the image leaves the page under its chrome and owns the screen; pinch, drag, swipe, wheel, every key in the table, deep links, a consumer rail

items.name: lightbox-motion
items.title: lightbox-motion
items.description: the lightbox's engine, framework-free: fit, source view, zoom at a point, rubber, pan bounds, momentum, commit rules, the stage band and one interruptible spring; the compositor flight (table, clock, landing); the held-key loop; the pointer state machine as a reducer; the wheel session, with the hand told apart from the device's coast

items.name: lightbox-actions
items.title: lightbox-actions
items.description: the lightbox's action registry: keys, layers, resolve, the escape ladder; one table drives dispatch, buttons, aria-keyshortcuts and the ? sheet. framework-free
